correctness.rationale: For each graph the rank-four type is the recursively computed set of all atomic diagrams reached by four ordered choices; induction on moves validates the recurrence, including equality and repeated selections. The complete C++17 census A1..A40, D4..D40, E6/E7/E8 yields exactly 33 groups, with an independently coded Python cross-check to index 22. The T_r=2T_(r-1)+1, T_0=1 gap invariant proves equivalence of all A_n from 33 and D_n from 35; connecting these tails to the finite thresholds proves the exact classification for unbounded n. Both codes replay from embedded paths, not a prior-run log.

value.rationale: The objects are the standard ADE simply laced Dynkin diagram graphs, not an ad hoc parameter slice. The theorem completely identifies what four nested first-order quantifiers can see across these infinite Lie-type families, including distinct E6/E7/E8, a sharp new D17 stabilization cutoff, and the optimal 17-vertex representative bound. The finite part is exhaustive and the all-order part structural; known A-case is contextual rather than being the contribution.
